DVBStreamer5 bundled SRT source lock
====================================

Upstream: Haivision SRT
Version: 1.5.7
Tag: v1.5.7
Release commit: 899348d8318eb9a3c5a5b6ec43c4a1114288773a
Source archive: srt_1.5.7.orig.tar.gz
Pinned SHA-256: 017cd1e437ef2073a4dd10ddf7b55e86bc3d6ebac0393d13bd22f6a57055d32b
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0

The archive is the Debian orig source corresponding to upstream SRT 1.5.7.
Run scripts/vendor_srt_source.sh to populate third_party/srt from the pinned archive.
Once populated, third_party/srt is intended to be committed with the project so
normal builds do not require network access or a system libsrt package.
